items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 12 at 8:47AM PDT until September 13 at 3:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northwest winds 15 to 25
kt with gusts up to 34 kt expected. For the Gale Warning,
northwest winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 3 PM PDT Sunday.
For the Gale Warning, from 3 PM to 9 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
